articles.title_en: Cap‐and‐Trade and Carbon Tax Meet Arrow–Debreu
articles.title_cn: 总量控制与交易和碳税相遇 Arrow-Debreu
articles.abstract_en: We propose two general equilibrium models, quota equilibrium, and emission tax equilibrium. Government specifies quotas or taxes on emissions, and then refrains from further action. All results remain valid regardless of how government chooses its emissions target. Quota equilibrium exists; the allocation of emission property rights impacts the distribution of welfare. If the only externality arises from total net emissions, quota equilibrium is Pareto optimal among all feasible outcomes with the same total net emissions. For certain tax rates, emission tax equilibrium may not exist. Every quota equilibrium can be realized as an emission tax equilibrium and vice versa. However, different quota prices may arise in equilibrium from a single quota, and different emission levels may arise in equilibrium from a single tax rate. This leads to inequivalence between quota and emission tax equilibria.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出二一般均衡模型、配额均衡和排放税均衡。政府规定排放配额或征税，然后避免采取进一步行动。无论政府如何选择排放目标，所有结果仍然有效。存在配额平衡；排放权的分配影响福利的分配。如果唯一的外部性来自总净排放量，则配额均衡在具有相同总净排放量的所有可行结果中是帕累托最优。对于某些税率，排放税均衡可能不存在。每个配额均衡都可以作为排放税均衡来实现，反之亦然。然而，在单一配额的均衡中可能会产生不同的配额价格，在单一税率的均衡中可能会产生不同的排放水平。这导致配额和排放税平衡之间的不平等。

articles.title_en: Choices and Outcomes in Assignment Mechanisms: The Allocation of Deceased Donor Kidneys
articles.title_cn: 分配机制的选择和结果：死者捐肾的分配
articles.abstract_en: While the mechanism design paradigm emphasizes notions of efficiency based on agent preferences, policymakers often focus on alternative objectives. School districts emphasize educational achievement, and transplantation communities focus on patient survival. It is unclear whether choice‐based mechanisms perform well when assessed based on these outcomes. This paper evaluates the assignment mechanism for allocating deceased donor kidneys on the basis of patient life‐years from transplantation (LYFT). We examine the role of choice in increasing LYFT and compare realized assignments to benchmarks that remove choice. Our model combines choices and outcomes in order to study how selection affects LYFT. We show how to identify and estimate the model using instruments derived from the mechanism. The estimates suggest that the design in use selects patients with better post‐transplant survival prospects and matches them well, resulting in an average LYFT of 9.29, which is 1.75 years more than a random assignment. However, the maximum aggregate LYFT is 14.08. Realizing the majority of the gains requires transplanting relatively healthy patients, who would have longer life expectancies even without a transplant. Therefore, a policymaker faces a dilemma between transplanting patients who are sicker and those for whom life will be extended the longest.
articles.abstract_cn: 虽然机制设计范式强调基于代理人偏好的效率概念，但政策制定者通常关注替代目标。学区强调教育成就，移植社区则关注患者的生存。目前尚不清楚基于选择的机制在根据这些结果进行评估时是否表现良好。本文评估了根据患者移植生命年（LYFT）分配已故供体肾脏的分配机制。我们研究了选择在增加 Lyft 中的作用，并将已实现的任务与消除选择的基准进行比较。我们的模型结合了选择和结果，以研究选择如何影响 Lyft。我们展示了如何使用从该机制派生的工具来识别和估计模型。估计表明，使用的设计选择了移植后生存前景较好的患者，并将其很好地匹配，导致平均 LYFT 为 9.29，比随机分配多 1.75 年。然而，最大总 LYFT 为 14.08。实现大部分成果需要移植相对健康的患者，即使不进行移植，他们的预期寿命也会更长。因此，政策制定者在移植病情较重的患者和那些能够延长生命的患者之间面临着两难境地。

articles.title_en: People Are More Moral in Uncertain Environments
articles.title_cn: 人们在不确定的环境中更加道德
articles.abstract_en: We conduct a series of experiments and document a robust behavioral pattern whereby people behave more morally in uncertain environments than degenerate deterministic ones. We show that this pattern is weakened when the moral implication of behavior is diminished or when uncertainty pertains to others rather than oneself. These findings are incompatible with standard models that respect dominance. We propose a mechanism based on the anxiety aspect of uncertain environments whereby people act morally as if their moral behavior can help deliver a better outcome. We further delve into the complexity aspect of uncertainty to arrive at a more comprehensive understanding of these findings.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们进行了一系列实验并记录了一种稳健的行为模式，在这种模式下，人们在不确定的环境中比在退化的确定性环境中表现得更加道德。我们表明，当行为的道德含义减弱或不确定性涉及他人而不是自己时，这种模式就会减弱。这些发现与尊重主导地位的标准模型不相容。我们提出了一种基于不确定环境的焦虑方面的机制，人们在这种机制中采取道德行为，就好像他们的道德行为可以帮助实现更好的结果一样。我们进一步深入研究不确定性的复杂性，以便对这些发现有更全面的理解。

articles.abstract_en: We estimate valence measures of candidates running in U.S. House elections from data on vote shares. Our identification and estimation strategy builds on ideas developed for estimating production functions, allowing us to control for possible endogeneity of campaign spending and sample selection of candidates due to endogenous entry. We find that incumbents have substantially higher valence measures than challengers running against them, resulting in about 3.5 percentage‐point differences in the vote share, on average. Eliminating differences in the valence of challengers and incumbents results in an increase in the winning probability of a challenger from 6.5% to 12.1%. Our measure of candidate valence can be used to study various substantive questions of political economy. We illustrate its usefulness by studying the source of incumbency advantage in U.S. House elections.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们根据投票份额数据估算参加美国众议院选举的候选人的效价指标。我们的识别和估计策略建立在为估计生产函数而开发的想法之上，使我们能够控制竞选支出和由于内生进入而导致的候选人样本选择的可能内生性。我们发现，现任者的效价衡量指标远高于与他们竞争的挑战者，导致平均投票份额存在约 3.5 个百分点的差异。消除挑战者和现任者效价的差异会导致挑战者的获胜概率从 6.5% 增加到 12.1%。我们对候选人效价的衡量可以用来研究政治经济学的各种实质性问题。我们通过研究美国众议院选举中现任优势的来源来说明其有用性。

articles.title_en: The Impact of Incarceration on Employment, Earnings, and Tax Filing
articles.title_cn: 监禁对就业、收入和纳税的影响
articles.abstract_en: We study the effect of incarceration on wages, self‐employment, and taxes and transfers in North Carolina and Ohio using two quasi‐experimental research designs: discontinuities in sentencing guidelines and random assignment to judges. Across both states, incarceration generates short‐term drops in economic activity while individuals remain in prison. As a result, a year‐long sentence decreases cumulative earnings over five years by 13%. Beyond five years, however, there is no evidence of lower employment, wage earnings, or self‐employment in either state, as well as among defendants with no prior incarceration history. These results suggest that upstream factors, such as other types of criminal justice interactions or pre‐existing labor market detachment, are more likely to be the cause of low earnings among the previously incarcerated, who we estimate would earn just $5000 per year on average if spared a prison sentence.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用二准实验研究设计：量刑指南的不连续性和法官的随机分配，研究了北卡罗来纳州和俄亥俄州监禁对工资、自营职业、税收和转移的影响。在这两个州，监禁会导致经济活动短期下降，而个人仍被监禁。因此，长达一年的刑期会使 五 年的累积收入减少 13%。然而，在五年之后，没有证据表明这两个州以及没有任何监禁历史的被告的就业、工资收入或自营职业较低。这些结果表明，上游因素，例如其他类型的刑事司法互动或先前存在的劳动力市场脱离，更有可能是先前被监禁者收入低的原因，我们估计，如果免于监禁，他们平均每年只能赚取5000美元。

articles.title_en: Double Robust Bayesian Inference on Average Treatment Effects
articles.title_cn: 对平均治疗效果的双重稳健贝叶斯推理
articles.abstract_en: We propose a double robust Bayesian inference procedure on the average treatment effect (ATE) under unconfoundedness. For our new Bayesian approach, we first adjust the prior distributions of the conditional mean functions, and then correct the posterior distribution of the resulting ATE. Both adjustments make use of pilot estimators motivated by the semiparametric influence function for ATE estimation. We prove asymptotic equivalence of our Bayesian procedure and efficient frequentist ATE estimators by establishing a new semiparametric Bernstein–von Mises theorem under double robustness; that is, the lack of smoothness of conditional mean functions can be compensated by high regularity of the propensity score and vice versa. Consequently, the resulting Bayesian credible sets form confidence intervals with asymptotically exact coverage probability. In simulations, our method provides precise point estimates of the ATE through the posterior mean and delivers credible intervals that closely align with the nominal coverage probability. Furthermore, our approach achieves a shorter interval length in comparison to existing methods. We illustrate our method in an application to the National Supported Work Demonstration following LaLonde (1986) and Dehejia and Wahba (1999).
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种关于无混杂因素下平均治疗效果（ATE）的双稳健贝叶斯推理程序。对于我们的新贝叶斯方法，我们第一调整条件均值函数的先验分布，然后纠正所得 ATE 的后验分布。这两种调整都利用了由 ATE 估计的半参数影响函数驱动的导频估计器。我们通过在双重鲁棒性下建立新的半参数 Bernstein-von Mises 定理，证明了贝叶斯过程和高效频率主义 ATE 估计器的渐近等价性；也就是说，条件均值函数缺乏平滑性可以通过倾向得分的高度规律性来补偿，反之亦然。因此，所得的贝叶斯可信集形成具有渐近精确覆盖概率的置信区间。在模拟中，我们的方法通过后验平均值提供 ATE 的精确点估计，并提供与标称覆盖概率紧密一致的可信区间。此外，与现有方法相比，我们的方法实现了更短的间隔长度。我们在 LaLonde（1986）以及 Dehejia 和 Wahba（1999）之后的国家支持工作示范中应用了我们的方法。

articles.title_en: On (Constrained) Efficiency of Strategy‐Proof Random Assignment
articles.title_cn: 关于策略证明随机分配的（受限）效率
articles.abstract_en: We study random assignment of indivisible objects among a set of agents, when each agent is to receive one object and has strict preferences over the objects. Random Serial Dictatorship (RSD) satisfies equal treatment of equals, ex post efficiency, and strategy‐proofness. Answering a longstanding open question, we show that RSD is not characterized by those properties—there are other mechanisms satisfying equal treatment of equals, ex post efficiency, and strategy‐proofness which are not welfare‐equivalent to RSD. On the other hand, we show that RSD is not Pareto dominated by any mechanism that is (i) strategy‐proof and (ii) boundedly invariant. Moreover, the same holds for all mechanisms that are ex post efficient, strategy‐proof, and boundedly invariant: no such mechanism is dominated by any other mechanism that is strategy‐proof and boundedly invariant.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究当每个智能体要接收 一 对象并且对对象有严格偏好时，在一组智能体之间随机分配不可分割的对象。随机串行独裁（RSD）满足平等对待、事后效率和策略验证性。在回答一个长期悬而未决的问题时，我们表明 RSD 并不具有这些属性——还有其他满足平等对待、事后效率和策略证明性的机制，这些机制与 RSD 并不等同于福利。另一方面，我们证明 RSD 不被任何 (i) 策略证明和 (ii) 有界不变的机制所支配。此外，这同样适用于所有事后有效、策略证明和有限不变的机制：没有这样的机制被任何其他策略证明和有限不变的机制所支配。

articles.title_en: Feedback Design in Dynamic Moral Hazard
articles.title_cn: 动态道德风险中的反馈设计
articles.abstract_en: We study the joint design of dynamic incentives and performance feedback for an environment with a coarse (all‐or‐nothing) measure of performance, and show that hiding information from the agent can be an optimal way to motivate effort. Using a novel approach to incentive compatibility, we derive a two‐phase solution that begins with a “silent phase” where the agent is given no feedback and is asked to work non‐stop, and ends with a “full‐transparency phase” where the agent stops working as soon as a performance threshold is met. Hiding information leads to greater effort, but an ignorant agent is also more expensive to motivate. The two‐phase solution—where the agent's ignorance is fully frontloaded—stems from a “backward compounding effect” that raises the cost of hiding information as time passes.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在具有粗略（全有或全无）绩效衡量的环境中动态激励和绩效反馈的联合设计，并表明向代理隐藏信息可能是激励努力的最佳方式。使用一种新颖的激励相容方法，我们得出了一个二阶段解决方案，该解决方案以“静默阶段”开始，在该阶段中，代理没有得到任何反馈，并被要求不间断地工作，并以“完全透明阶段”结束，在该阶段中，一旦达到性能阈值，代理就会停止工作。隐藏信息会带来更大的努力，但激励无知的代理人的成本也更高。 二阶段的解决方案——智能体的无知被完全前置——源于“向后复合效应”，随着时间的推移，隐藏信息的成本会增加。

articles.abstract_en: Is more novel research always desirable? We develop a model in which knowledge shapes society's policies and guides the search for discoveries. Researchers select a question and how intensely to study it. The novelty of a question determines both the value and difficulty of discovering its answer. We show that the benefits of discoveries are nonmonotone in novelty. Knowledge expands endogenously step‐by‐step over time. Through a dynamic externality, moonshots—research on questions more novel than what is myopically optimal—can improve the evolution of knowledge. Moonshots induce research cycles in which subsequent researchers connect the moonshot to previous knowledge.
articles.abstract_cn: 更多新颖的研究总是可取的吗？我们开发了一个模型，让知识塑造社会政策并指导对发现的探索。研究人员选择一个问题以及研究它的强度。问题的新颖性决定了发现其答案的价值和难度。我们表明，发现的好处在新颖性方面是非单调的。随着时间的推移，知识会逐步内生扩展。通过动态的外部性，登月计划（对比短视最优问题更新颖的问题进行研究）可以改善知识的进化。登月计划引发了研究周期，随后的研究人员将登月计划与之前的知识联系起来。

articles.title_en: Comparative Statics With Adjustment Costs and the Le Chatelier Principle
articles.title_cn: 具有调整成本的比较静态分析和勒夏特列原理
articles.abstract_en: We develop a theory of monotone comparative statics for models with adjustment costs. We show that comparative‐statics conclusions may be drawn under the usual ordinal complementarity assumptions on the objective function, assuming very little about costs: only a mild monotonicity condition is required. We use this insight to prove a general Le Chatelier principle: under the ordinal complementarity assumptions, if short‐run adjustment is subject to a monotone cost, then the long‐run response to a shock is greater than the short‐run response. We extend these results to a fully dynamic model of adjustment over time: the Le Chatelier principle remains valid, and under slightly stronger assumptions, optimal adjustment follows a monotone path. We apply our results to models of saving, production, pricing, labor supply, and investment.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们为具有调整成本的模型开发了单调比较静态理论。我们表明，比较静态的结论可以在目标函数的通常序数互补假设下得出，对成本的假设很少：只需要温和的单调性条件。我们利用这一见解来证明一般的勒夏特列原理：在序数互补假设下，如果短期调整受到单调成本的影响，那么对冲击的长期反应大于短期反应。我们将这些结果扩展到随时间变化的完全动态调整模型：勒夏特列原理仍然有效，并且在稍强的假设下，最优调整遵循单调路径。我们将研究结果应用于储蓄、生产、定价、劳动力供应和投资模型。

articles.abstract_en: There has been a call for caution regarding the standard procedure for Bayesian inference in set‐identified structural vector autoregressions on the grounds that the common practice of using a uniform prior over the set of orthogonal matrices induces a non‐uniform prior for individual impulse responses or other quantities of interest. This paper challenges this call by formally showing that when the focus is on joint inference, the uniform prior over the set of orthogonal matrices is not only sufficient but also necessary for inference based on a uniform joint prior distribution over the identified set for the vector of impulse responses. In addition, we show how to conduct inference based on a uniform joint prior distribution for the vector of impulse responses.
articles.abstract_cn: 有人呼吁谨慎对待集合识别的结构向量自回归中贝叶斯推理的标准程序，因为在正交矩阵集上使用均匀先验的常见做法会导致个体脉冲响应或其他感兴趣的量产生非均匀先验。本文对这一呼吁提出了挑战，正式表明，当重点是联合推理时，正交矩阵集上的均匀先验不仅足够，而且对于基于脉冲响应向量的已识别集合上的均匀联合先验分布的推理来说也是必要的。此外，我们还展示了如何基于脉冲响应向量的均匀联合先验分布进行推理。

articles.title_en: A Comment on: “Autoregressive Conditional Duration: A New Model for Irregularly Spaced Transaction Data”
articles.title_cn: 对“自回归条件持续时间：不规则间隔交易数据的新模型”的评论
articles.abstract_en: Based on the GARCH literature, Engle and Russell (1998) established consistency and asymptotic normality of the QMLE for the autoregressive conditional duration (ACD) model, assuming strict stationarity and ergodicity of the durations. Using novel arguments based on renewal process theory, we show that their results hold under the stronger requirement that durations have finite expectation. However, we demonstrate that this is not always the case under the assumption of stationary and ergodic durations. Specifically, we provide a counterexample where the MLE is asymptotically mixed normal and converges at a rate significantly slower than usual. The main difference between ACD and GARCH asymptotics is that the former must account for the number of durations in a given time span being random. As a by‐product, we present a new lemma which can be applied to analyze asymptotic properties of extremum estimators when the number of observations is random.
articles.abstract_cn: 基于 GARCH 文献，Engle 和 Russell (1998) 为自回归条件久期 (ACD) 模型建立了 QMLE 的一致性和渐近正态性，并假设久期的严格平稳性和遍历性。使用基于更新过程理论的新颖论点，我们表明他们的结果在持续时间具有有限期望的更强要求下成立。然而，我们证明，在平稳和遍历持续时间的假设下，情况并非总是如此。具体来说，我们提供了一个反例，其中 MLE 是渐近混合正态的，并且收敛速度明显慢于平常。 ACD 和 GARCH 渐进之间的主要区别在于，前者必须考虑给定时间跨度内随机的持续时间数量。作为副产品，我们提出了一个新的引理，可用于分析观测数量随机时极值估计量的渐近性质。
